name: Every Dismantlable-Ample Obstruction Is Periphery-Free
statement: Every pc-minimal obstruction to dismantlable ampleness has no peripheral coordinate. Consequently every such obstruction other than the nonample families $Q_n^{--}$ for $n\ge3$ is ample, periphery-free, and Cartesian-prime.
proof: If a coordinate were peripheral, orient it so the obstruction were $(B\times\{0\})\cup(S\times\{1\})$ with $S\subseteq B$. Its contraction base $B$ and duplicated site $S$ are proper pc-minors and hence dismantlable ample. The exact peripheral-expansion criterion would then make the whole family dismantlable ample, a contradiction. The known nonample obstruction layer and the product-prime lemma give the remaining conclusions.
